title: Backward-facing step, expansion ratio ER=2, Re=5000
geometry: Channel with sudden expansion: pre-step height h=1, post-step height H=2, streamwise length 10h, unit spanwise width
question: Compute the streamwise reattachment length L (measured from the step edge to where the wall shear stress changes sign on the lower wall). Report L/h.

reference.source: Kim, Kline, Johnston, J. Fluids Eng. 102 (1980)

notes: Kim 1980 reports L/h between 5.5 and 6.5 across turbulence treatments at Re=5000 ER=2. ±10% relative tolerance. Inlet velocity profile should be fully developed channel flow; outlet is zero-gradient pressure outlet.
